$comment: PADR-0049 decision 2.8: every path a workflow may hand to a cache or upload action and every asset of gh release create|upload, literally; and the actions known not to save or publish files, pinned by SHA. tools/check-workflows.ts (npm run check) refuses anything else. The draw.io runtime is never among them.

actions.actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da7: checks out the repository; saves and publishes nothing
actions.actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd: installs Node; every use turns its package-manager cache off
actions.actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bd: downloads an artifact of the same run; publishes nothing
actions.gitleaks/gitleaks-action@e0c47f4f8be36e2: scans the git history; anything it uploads is its own findings report, never a path a workflow names
